messages:
runtime-lead: started canary for rollout v2.3.7 at 10:11 UTC, small A/B across kernel-selection variants. noticing p99 tail jump on seq=512 tests.
kevin: saw CI perf job #482 fail earlier — flagged kernel-selector heuristics on that branch. p50 ok, p99 +2.7x.
maria: confirming in canary dashboards — baseline p99 ~220ms, canary shows ~620ms for the same traffic slice. tokens/s drop ~30%. attaching quick profile.
alex: uploading profiler snippet — looks like attention kernel A -> B switch caused more GPU memcpy and extra kernel launches. also KV cache miss rate up ~12% on canary. suspect interplay with new kv-heuristic.
maria: profiler excerpt:
```
# sample timeline (aggregated)
0.0ms  dispatch
1.8ms  attention_kernel_launch (fused_attn_v2)
3.2ms  cudnn_conv fallback
7.0ms  KV cache miss + recompute
...
p99=620ms tokens/s=125
```
kevin: FYI CI perf diff: `tools/perf/regressions --job=kernel-selection` returned:
```
regression: p99 +310ms
changed_files: runtime/kernel_selector.cpp runtime/kv_heuristic.cc
```
deploy-bot: canary metrics alert: `canary-v2.3.7` p99 > 2x baseline for 3m window -> ALERT.
sre-bot: automatically pausing gradual rollout per policy `canary_auto_pause_on_perf`.
runtime-lead: ok good — pause confirmed. we should decide: revert the kernel selector change or tweak gating thresholds / kv heuristic. thoughts? :thinking_face:
maria: I can run a bisect across the merge window. suspect commit range `a1b2c3..d4e5f6` where kernel-autoselect landed. will try `git bisect run ./tools/perf/ci-check.sh` locally.
alex: another datapoint — kv eviction changed default from LRU->segLRU in the same PR chain. segLRU reduces long-tail mem use but increases short-context misses for small seqs. that could amplify kernel-cost per request.
kevin: can we reproduce with a synthetic workload? i'll fire a local canary with seq=512, batch sizing matching production (dynamic batching turned on). if it reproduces we can test flipping back kv->LRU quickly.
kevin: quick command I'm running:
```
# reproduce locally
export PERF_WORKERS=64
./dev/run_canary --model rlhf-v1 --seq 512 --dynamic-batching=on --kernel-variant=autoselect
```
maria: if bisect pins it to kernel-selector change, we should open a hotfix PR to temporarily pin kernel choice to v1 for canary/dedicated until we finish perf tuning. rollback policy: immediate revert if p99 > 1.8x baseline for 5m OR tokens/s drop >20% for 3m (sre agrees).
sre-bot: noted. creating incident docket and paging oncall.
runtime-lead: proposal: keep canary paused, start bisect, test quick flip of KV policy + pinned kernel on a separate canary slot. if pinned-kernel restores baseline, promote a revert PR.
alex: I'll prepare a config patch to gate rollout rules and add an automated rollback condition. snippet:
```
rollout_gates:
  - name: perf-slo
    metric: p99_latency_ms
    threshold: 1.8x
    window: 300s
    action: rollback
  - name: throughput-drop
    metric: tokens_per_sec
    threshold: "-20%"
    window: 180s
    action: pause
```
maria: timeline: bisect ~30m, local reproduce ~15m, test KV flip/pin kernel ~20m. will update thread with commit hash.
kevin: if anyone needs quick revert: `infractl deploy revert --to=main~1 --env=canary`
runtime-lead: thanks all. assigning follow-ups: maria=bisect, kevin=local repro + KV flip test, alex=gate config PR, runtime-lead=open hotfix PR if bisect positive. we'll reconvene in 40m. :thumbsup:
